items.title: American Drops Lawsuit Over Gates at Chicago O’Hare but It’s Still Locked in a Battle With United
items.snippet: Skift Take: American has spent much of the year building back its Chicago presence, even earning another gate at O’Hare just from increasing capacity at the airport, which has been the backdrop of an intense turf war with United.

items.title: Lufthansa Group Launches One App for Six Airlines – But Will Travelers Use It?
items.snippet: The Lufthansa Group has released a new app combining bookings, check-in and loyalty services across six airlines, offering travelers greater convenience while raising questions about its commercial ambitions and existing airline apps.

items.title: A hotel flag should be more than a name above the door
items.snippet: Choice Hotels' Raul Ramirez outlines how franchisors evaluate property fit, support owner economics, and compete on distribution as AI reshapes how guests discover and book hotels.

items.title: Hospitality Asset Forum 2026 : Hospitality, a constrained market but an asset class that holds up
items.snippet: Scarce land, longer timelines, rising costs: developing a hotel in France has never been so demanding. At the Hospitality Asset Forum 2026, MSCI, MKG and BNP Paribas Real Estate nevertheless showed that hospitality absorbs these shocks better than most other asset classes.

items.title: OYO eyes Q1 2027 IPO at reported INR 20,000-22,000 crore valuation
items.snippet: Oravel Stays is reportedly preparing for another attempt at a public listing, with a proposed fresh issue of INR 3,350 crore, as investors assess the hospitality company’s profitability and international business.

items.title: AVIAREPS hosts second ‘Around the World’ roadshow in India with 5 partners
items.snippet: AVIAREPS India has successfully concluded the second edition of its flagship ‘Around the World’ Roadshow in India, completing a three-city programme across Delhi, Mumbai and Chennai.

items.title: Azerbaijan Tourism hosts 3-city India roadshow for promotion beyond Baku
items.snippet: Azerbaijan Tourism Board (ATB) concluded its three-city roadshow across Chennai, Ahmedabad and New Delhi, reinforcing its commitment to the Indian market and strengthening engagement with the country’s travel trade.

items.title: ABNAH bets on talent, technology and experience to scale India’s evolving dining-out market
items.snippet: Aditya Birla New Age Hospitality (ABNAH) has entered Bengaluru with Supa San, marking the Japanese-inspired brand’s first restaurant in the city. For CEO Udai Pinnali, the launch reflects a broader conviction: that India’s dining-out market is expanding, and consumers increasingly seek well-designed, quality-led experiences.

items.title: Six Senses debuts in the UAE with the opening of Six Senses The Palm, Dubai
items.snippet: Six Senses has marked its debut in the United Arab Emirates with the opening of Six Senses The Palm, Dubai, on the West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah. The beachfront resort comprises 61 suites and 172 private residences, bringing together wellness, contemporary design, destination-inspired experiences and residential living.
